create_RASampler_for_distributed_trainin: create a RASampler instance for distributed training with repeated augmentations across multiple GPU replicas
use_RASampler_shuffler_for_repeated_indi: use the RASampler shuffler method to generate repeated shuffled indices for data augmentation
iterate_RASampler_for_epoch_indices: iterate over a RASampler to get subsampled indices for the current rank in distributed training
set_RASampler_epoch: set the epoch on a RASampler instance to control shuffling behavior for the current training epoch
collate_batch_with_list_collate: collate a batch of variable-sized tensors into a list using the list_collate function
